name: Recurse
description: The same trick at two depths: a coarse inner grid with a finer one masked out of it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: @p(#000, #0000);); mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: @p(#000, #0000);); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 20%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 6 / 100%; background: @p(#000, #0000, #0000);); mask: @doodle(@grid: 6 / 100%; background: @p(#000, #0000, #0000);); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
